headline: Revenue and ARR growth accelerate as operating losses narrow
summary_short: SentinelOne's fiscal Q1 2027 (three months ended April 30, 2026) revenue grew 21% y/y to $276.7 million and ARR grew 23% to $1,162.6 million, while the GAAP operating loss narrowed to $79.7 million from $87.5 million and non-GAAP operating income swung positive to $10.5 million from a $3.9 million loss.
summary_long: Revenue growth came from new-customer sales and additional licenses/platform solutions to existing customers; cost of revenue rose 38% on cloud hosting, support headcount, and acquisition intangible amortization. R&D rose 33% on headcount and acquisition-linked stock compensation; S&M fell 1% on lower marketing spend. Customers with ARR ≥$100K grew 17% to 1,702. Cash, equivalents and investments totaled $812.5 million; adjusted free cash flow was $61.4 million (22% margin) vs $45.4 million a year earlier, aided by a $30.7 million discrete ITA tax payment add-back. The company raised its non-GAAP operating income outlook, guiding FY2027 revenue to $1.195-1.205 billion, non-GAAP operating income to $115-125 million, and non-GAAP diluted EPS to $0.32-0.38.

drivers.explanation: Record net new ARR growth and operating leverage from scaling the business drove the swing to positive non-GAAP operating income; management cited demand for AI, Data, Cloud and Endpoint security solutions.
Increase of $47.6 million primarily due to sales to new customers and sales of additional licenses and platform solutions to existing customers.
Grew 23% y/y primarily driven by a combination of new customer additions and adoption of adjacent platform solutions by existing customers.

Cost of revenue rose 38% on cloud hosting, customer support and acquisition-related intangible amortization, and R&D rose 33% on headcount, but revenue growth and a 1% decline in S&M expense narrowed the operating loss.

Free cash flow of $30.7 million plus a $30.7 million add-back for a discrete cash income tax payment tied to the Israeli Tax Authority settlement agreement produced $61.4 million adjusted free cash flow.
